messages:
incident-bot: Pager: billing-metering anomaly detected in eu-west-1. Large token_count delta vs baseline; delayed aggregate and several transient overage flags. Paging @sre-oncall @billing-ops :rotating_light:

sre-oncall: on it. seeing a sharp jump in token emits around 06:02 UTC. starting quick triage.

billing-ops: confirmed. quick check shows ~120k emitted tokens in the 5m window vs ~2k normal. dashboards spiking.

mika: note — we rolled router-service v2026.03.18 to eu-west-1 at 05:57. it changed ACK retry behavior (added aggressive resend in edge cases).

billing-ops: running a quick query to confirm duplicate acks pattern:
```sql
SELECT ack_id, count(*) as cnt, min(emitted_at)
FROM token_emits
WHERE emitted_at >= now() - interval '10 minutes'
  AND region = 'eu-west-1'
GROUP BY ack_id
HAVING count(*) > 1
ORDER BY cnt DESC
LIMIT 10;
```

billing-ops: query shows repeated ack_id clusters, many with cnt=3-4. looks like resend loop leading to duplicate counting in the aggregator.

sre-oncall: can we short-circuit the aggregator dedupe window? toggling config to ignore duplicates for 60s might stop the immediate surge.

incident-bot: automated mitigation suggestion: disable emitter-replay in eu-west-1 while investigating.

billing-ops: toggled `dedupe.window_ms` from 30000 -> 5000 for eu-west-1 to reduce sensitivity to burst replays.

mika: i'm going to rollback router-service to v2026.03.17 in eu-west-1 now — route traffic down and observe.

sre-oncall: command used:
```bash
kubectl -n router rollout undo deployment/router-service --to-revision=42  # rollback to 2026.03.17 tag
```

sre-oncall: rollout started, monitoring pods. healthchecks green on new pods coming up.

devon: starting a reconciliation dry-run to estimate correction size:
```bash
./scripts/reconcile_billing --region eu-west-1 --from 1745667000 --to 1745667890 --dry-run --output /tmp/recon-estimate.json
```

billing-ops: sample from logs showing duplicate ack pattern:
```
[06:01:58] emitter: ack=hd_9f4a resending (retry=2)
[06:01:59] emitter: ack=hd_9f4a resending (retry=3)
[06:02:00] aggregator: received ack=hd_9f4a count=1
[06:02:00] aggregator: received ack=hd_9f4a count=2
```

anna: customer-impact note: small set of customers (~12) showed immediate dashboard spikes and automated overage warnings; billing emails were queued but we have not applied charges. recommend holding charges until post-recon. preparing a short customer note if we confirm visible spikes persist >1h.

sre-oncall: passing on-call to @devon for morning shift. handoff summary:
- root cause suspected: router v2026.03.18 ack-resend regression
- mitigations performed: dedupe window tweak, emitter-replay disabled for eu-west-1, router rollback started
- immediate next steps: run reconciliation, run backfill to correct counts, validate dedupe effectiveness, monitor for delayed usage reports
- customer action: hold charges, draft comms if spikes persist

devon: ack, taking over. ETA for first reconciliation summary 30m. will post updates here and escalate if recon > 2h or corrections > 5%. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0331-EUW-METER-ACK-REPLAY. severity: P2. Assigned: devon (oncall).
